topic: current-regime material-harm routing separated from cumulative safety certification

public_evidence.source: Shin, Ramdas, Rinaldo, E-detectors: A Nonparametric Framework for Sequential Change Detection
public_evidence.result: For bounded observations with conditional pre-change mean at most m, L_n^lambda=1+lambda(X_n/m-1), lambda in (0,1), is a valid baseline increment even with time-varying dependent means. e-SR/e-CUSUM procedures built from e-detectors nonasymptotically control average run length; with the universal 1/alpha threshold the paper recommends e-SR because it dominates e-CUSUM at the same threshold.

derived_theorem.claim: Let the raw-time weighted paired gap d_t from r117 satisfy d_t in [a,b], with a=-0.09, b=0.4. Choose a declared material weighted harm threshold m in [0,b). Under the no-material-harm condition E[d_t|F_{t-1}]<=m, define X_t=(d_t-a)/(b-a), p0=(m-a)/(b-a), and L_t^lambda=1+lambda(X_t/p0-1)=1+lambda(d_t-m)/(m-a), 0<lambda<1. Then L_t is nonnegative and E[L_t|F_{t-1}]<=1. The e-SR recursion R_t=L_t(R_{t-1}+1), R_0=0, stopped at R_t>=1/alpha_local, has average run length at least 1/alpha_local under no material weighted harm.

This local e-SR is a routing detector, not a second global safety certificate. Its alarm should only shrink/fallback the proposal toward the defensive base, so a false alarm costs efficiency but does not bias the target estimator or invalidate r117's cumulative 5% CS. Reusing/restarting local e-SR episodes preserves only per-episode ARL semantics, not a global probability of ever false-routing; irreversible actions would require alpha spending/PFA accounting instead.

For defensive floor e=0.6, B=25/9 and S(q_mix)-S(base)<=B E[d], a future-horizon tolerated variance excess V_tol over H raw samples corresponds to weighted threshold m=V_tol/(B H). Alarm on weighted harm is conservative: weighted excess may be positive while actual convex-mixture excess is smaller, but any actual excess above V_tol implies the weighted upper comparator must exceed this threshold on average.

detectability_diagnostic.status: engineering/information-scale diagnostic, not a nonstationary e-SR delay theorem
detectability_diagnostic.source_variation: r116 recurring synthetic predictable paired quadratic variation 0.817459 over 100k raw samples, giving V_per_raw≈8.17459e-6
detectability_diagnostic.local_false_routing_setting: alpha_local=1e-5, universal e-SR threshold=1e5 and hence ARL>=100k per episode under the null
detectability_diagnostic.approximation: For a small persistent alternative whose mean exceeds the material threshold by Delta and paired conditional variance is approximately V, optimal small-bet log-growth is about Delta^2/(2V), yielding delay≈2 V log(1/alpha_local)/Delta^2. This is a local quadratic approximation used only to diagnose evidence scale.
detectability_diagnostic.assumed_alternative: mean weighted harm is approximately 2m, so Delta=m
detectability_diagnostic.prior_static_harm_scale: The own r117 static-post harmful stress had mean weighted cumulative normalized gap about 0.34053 over 100k, i.e. ~3.41e-6 per raw sample. Using the same variance scale, even detecting any positive harm at ARL 100k has an approximate evidence time around 16.2 million raw samples. This explains why sparse high-fidelity failures cannot be the sole fast local-routing signal for subtle drift.

design_consequence.claim: Use two distinct local mechanisms: (1) a low-fidelity proxy/state drift signal may trigger reversible shrinkage toward base early because it is cheap and dense, but it is never a truth certificate; (2) the high-fidelity paired e-SR catches only materially large persistent harm with explicit ARL semantics. Keep r117's cumulative anytime CS as the statistical noninferiority certificate. This separates fast routing, local high-fidelity confirmation and cumulative safety instead of forcing one sparse signal to do all three jobs.

negative_or_scope_evidence: The delay table uses a small-signal quadratic log-growth approximation and r116 synthetic variation; it is not a theorem for adaptive nonstationary controller trajectories.
ARL control is not global PFA. Repeated reversible fallbacks may occur eventually under the null.
A weighted-comparator alarm can be conservative because convexity only says actual mixture second moment is no larger than the weighted expert average.
Fast low-fidelity routing must remain reversible and must not be used to claim high-fidelity safety or deployment-risk probability.
No real-agent or AGI performance conclusion follows.
next_tests: Choose an operational V_tol/H materiality pair and instantiate a small predeclared mixture of e-SR lambda values; measure actual delay under synthetic abrupt materially-harmful regimes and false fallback cost under benign regimes.
Build a cheap proxy-drift shrinkage controller whose only action is monotone/reversible movement toward base; quantify how much high-fidelity variance loss it prevents before the e-SR can react.
Preserve cumulative r117 CS separately and explicitly report three semantics: cumulative certification, local high-fidelity ARL routing, and low-fidelity heuristic routing.
Extend the local factor to the general defensive floor e using a=-e^2/4, b=1-e and test how floor choice changes local evidence rate as well as cumulative certification.
